packageRules.description: We choose the Node version by hand, so turn off version bumps for these two images. Scoped to update types rather than using ignoreDeps so the carve-out stays accurate if digest updates are ever switched back on below.

No routine digest churn. A new upstream digest is not evidence that ours is bad, and a rebuilt base image is not reviewable — a weekly stream of opaque hash bumps trains people to rubber-stamp them. We bump a pin deliberately when something tells us the pinned image is actually vulnerable. Note this only stops refreshes of existing pins: pinDigests still adds a digest to any newly introduced image.
